ground_truth_evidence: category 5: none: the off-by-one copies one extra in-struct word (ctx->M[16], inside srtp_sha1_ctx_t), so no out-of-bounds access occurs; it only makes every SHA-1/HMAC output wrong, an input-independent effect the harness never reports.

review.note: 10 random inputs, none crashed (run.out); sanitizer_report.txt is empty

category5.design: The injected `i <= (octets_in_buffer+3)/4` in srtp_sha1_final reads one extra word of ctx->M, which stays inside the context struct, so there is no memory error; it only corrupts every SHA-1 digest. The effect is input-independent and invisible to srtp-fuzzer, so no PoV can separate the builds by a crash; the spec keeps srtp-fuzzer and marks the task unusable.
